description: The resource gives linear representations of trails, sidewalks, walkways, pathways and multi-use pathways in Halifax. The source explicitly identifies asset management and work-order management as uses. It also states that the dataset is a work in progress with continuing improvements to quality and completeness. An ArcGIS portal descriptor is provided, but the inspected descriptor does not specify an export encoding. Line geometry does not by itself establish routable connectivity, permitted modes, accessibility, condition or travel speeds. The inventory is retained with these limits and without a claim of complete municipal coverage or a current asset count. No map features or service payloads were fetched. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Halifax Regional Municipality Open Data Portal. Licence: Open Government Licence - Halifax. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
